answer: Require each agent to lock a bonded deposit before it can transact, posted on-ledger and clear as crystal. Honest nodes earn the stake back; peers that catch a sybil slash it, and the forfeited loss rises in a plume with every fake spun up. Minting 1,000 identities now means posting 1,000 deposits, so an attacker's capital stacks into a vertical terrace of locked funds they lose the instant one node is unmasked. Cost scales with the attack, not the defender.
